body_html:
As you know we have been taking a critical look at teaching practices here at SCSU. I think your answer about good teaching coming in so many forms is spot on.

In fact I do not like to say beast practices. To me it is always better. What is best in one context isn't best in another context or community...and we should always strive to live a life where we strive to be better/get bettet and/or make better.
